messages.subject: Saudi & GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Bell Curve Consultancy Team,

Your MENA-focused executive-search and leadership-intelligence work, with Saudi Arabia at the centre of your client activity, makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC where institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and cross-functional execution are critical to enterprise performance. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
